component: Scoped asynchronous operation and listener result boundary

quotes.text: log::error!("aborting copy: an error occurred while stopping the listener: {err}")

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The historical create-listener proposal ignores the result of its success callback, while the prior code and exact backout log an OnStopCreate failure. Accepted current DoOperation instead warns when a success callback returns an error. Keep the completed remote operation and the listener result separate when describing diagnostics or completion. Logging does not undo the remote operation or prove local storage success. The callback interface itself changed later; no callback-failure or copy test ran.
title: An Exchange operation can succeed while its completion listener returns an error
